title: Thai-Style Zesty Flatbread
description: A tasty Thai-inspired flatbread recipe with a zesty twist. Perfect for a quick snack or light meal.
instructions: Combine polish flour and water in a bowl to form a dough.
Knead the dough for about 5 minutes until it becomes smooth.
Divide the dough into 2-3 equal pieces.
Roll out each piece into a thin circle.
Cook the flatbread in a dry pan over medium heat for about 2 minutes on each side.
Brush the flatbread with zesty sauce (store-bought or homemade).
